channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: ‘Have y’all not learned?’ Agents accused of getting more aggressive as ICE pushback grows
item.description: Local attorneys are fielding dozens of complaints that ICE has wrongfully detained, threatened and physically abused bystanders amid the Trump administration’s ongoing immigration crackdown in Minnesota.

item.title: Lynx kittens spotted in Voyageurs for first time in years
item.description: A decade after scientists found “no resident lynx” in the park, a feline family passing by a trail camera gives hope.

item.title: Takeaways: Wild pummeled by Jets 6-2 for third loss in a row
item.description: The Wild gave up two goals right at the end of the first period and were booed in their fifth consecutive loss at home.

item.title: FBI offers reward in connection with damage, theft from government vehicles in Minneapolis
item.description: The vehicles were damaged during the unrest after a man was shot Wednesday night.

item.title: If you’re feeling rage and despair, social media is doing its job
item.description: A St. Thomas professor says it can be healthy to step away.

item.title: ICE detainee with severe skin disorder is going home
item.description: Judge allows Libyan asylum-seeker to post bond and avoid further detention, but family said he suffered malnourishment and wounds related to restraints.

item.title: U of M medical school dean leaving amid instability
item.description: Dr. Jakub Tolar, who led the medical school since 2017, has been named CEO at Baylor College of Medicine in Texas.

item.title: Operation Metro Surge has no end date. How long could it last?
item.description: Previous enforcement campaigns often began with a surge, then quietly scaled back after a few months.

item.title: Renee Good had four gunshot wounds, fire department report reveals
item.description: Newly acquired documents describe Good’s injuries after she was shot by an ICE agent Jan. 7.

item.title: The latest: Trump threatens to send troops to Minnesota after federal agent shoots man over alleged attack
item.description: The war of words between state and federal officials escalated as the president threatened to invoke the Insurrection Act to quell anti-ICE protests.
